'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**During three separate attacks, a 14-year-old [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] boy is killed by [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] in a village near [[Ramallah]], in the [[West Bank]], while a 17-year-old Palestinian boy is killed and his mother wounded when Israeli soldiers open fire at residents during confrontations with [[Israeli settlement|Israeli settlers]].In al-Mazra’a al-Gharbiyah, witnesses said Israeli soldiers opened fire at the residents during confrontations with Israeli settlers, killing a 17-year-old Palestinian and wounding another. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/7/israeli-forces-kill-two-palestinian-teens-in-occupied-west-bank (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Communist rebellion in the Philippines]]
**Two [[Philippine Army|soldiers]] are killed and three [[civilian]]s are injured when five [[drug gang]]s open fire during a attack on a senator's convoy in clashes with [[airstrikes]], [[prison riot]]s, [[mass shooting]], and mass stabbing between the military and the [[New People's Army]] in [[Eastern Samar]], [[Philippines]]. [https://english.news.cn/20221007/962db7dae66b4eefa30ea59b8dc34a67/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**The [[Somali Armed Forces]] kill 19 [[al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] militants in [[Balad, Somalia|Bal'ad]], [[Middle Shabelle]], in a repelled attack amid ongoing operations against the [[jihadist]] group. [https://allafrica.com/stories/202210070556.html (allAfrica)]
*Seven [[Djibouti Armed Forces|soldiers]] are killed and four injured during an attack at an army base in Garabtisan, [[Djibouti]], by [[Front for the Restoration of Unity and Democracy|Armed FRUD]] gunmen. Both the attackers are killed. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/8/djibouti-says-seven-soldiers-killed-in-armed-group-attack (Al Jazeera)]
